answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must acquire and lock fresh pigment for every fake identity, burning real capital each time and risking slashing if behavior diverges. Each agent stakes a unique on-chain pigment token tied to a verified lantern identity, renewed per epoch. Honest peers cross-attest in an open meadow of reputation, so fake nodes stand out and their stakes are forfeited. Cost scales linearly with each extra identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
